verdict.rationale: Unity offers CLI/headless mode and Build Automation for CI pipelines (unity-docs-6,7,8,25,28) and an MCP server/AI Assistant that lets LLM agents drive workflows via natural-language prompts (unity-docs-23,24), which together enable some automated, unattended build/workflow execution. However there is no evidence of a persistent, self-scheduling agent that runs autonomously in the background without a triggering event or active session — automation here is either CI-triggered or requires an interactive AI Assistant/MCP client. Missing for 10: evidence of scheduled/standalone autonomous agent execution, background task orchestration independent of CI triggers or live MCP client sessions, and any hands-on confirmation of this working end-to-end.
